frequency_question: What proportion of major capital-intensive industrial subsidy schemes are successfully finalized and implemented within the targeted window?
membership_rule: Includes central government budgetary schemes targeting capital/subsidy support for manufacturing or adoption of heavy vehicles/clean tech; excludes routine administrative amendments or sub-100 million minor grants.
